entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, hello. I... I have a VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I think I need to return it. I'm a bit confused about how this works.
I can certainly help you with that. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. To be honest, I just... I think I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** around the holidays.
I see. So you're finding you just don't use it as much as you expected?
Exactly. I just **don't use it**. It's all a bit overwhelming with the numbers and the app. The website made it seem so simple. I don't know... can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me pull up your account and our return guidelines. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Let me just check the policy here.
Alright, thank you for waiting. According to my system, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since your purchase was only 24 days ago, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh! Really? So I can return it? That's such a relief.

Absolutely. I can process that return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's wonderful. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy.

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchases. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
